params.prompt: A normal grounded human WALK AWAY FROM THE VIEWER, seen directly from behind. Animate the exact rear-view illustrated woman in the reference. This is ordinary relaxed forward walking toward the TOP of the image (north), not exercise or dancing. Show it as a stationary treadmill walk so her body stays centered and the camera never moves. The gait must show forward locomotion: the LEFT foot plants ahead under the body and supports her weight while the RIGHT foot stays behind, rolls through its toe, then swings forward close to the floor and plants ahead; then repeat with the opposite leg. Smooth alternating left-right weight transfer with a brief double-support phase. At least ONE FOOT IS ALWAYS ON THE GROUND. Never lift both feet together. Legs move forward and backward along two parallel lanes at hip width. Natural heel-to-toe foot roll; modest knee flexion; low toe clearance; no foot crossing, lateral steps, kicking, high knees, skipping, hopping, jumping, tiptoe bouncing or hopscotch. Three to four complete left-right cycles across six seconds at an even unhurried walking pace. Arms gently counter-swing naturally close to her sides. Pelvis, shoulders and head stay almost level, with only subtle natural walking motion. Her back stays square to camera; no turning. Keep the exact reference proportions, constant height and size, fixed framing and full body including boots visible throughout. Preserve her dark brown bun, graphite quilted suit, blue shoulder patches, silver trim, rectangular backpack and all belt equipment rigidly attached in the same places. Three blue-cap silver cylinders on anatomical right hip; cyan scanner on left. Keep identical neutral lighting, colours and crisp 2D illustrated rendering. Solid flat green background. No shadows, text, camera movement or perspective change.
